description: This Java source file defines the `ParametricSearch` class, which provides utilities for performing parameterized searches based on product features within an e-commerce framework (Apache OFBiz). Its functionalities include retrieving features associated with product categories, building feature maps from HTTP request parameters, and managing feature-related collections.

classes.name: ParametricSearch
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for retrieving and manipulating product feature data, especially for search functionality based on product categories and features.

methods.name: makeCategoryFeatureLists
methods.description: Retrieves all features associated with a specific product category, organizing them by feature type. It considers features from both product categories and feature groups, returning a sorted map of features.

methods.name: getAllFeaturesByType
methods.description: Fetches all product features grouped by feature type, with an optional limit per type to handle large datasets.

methods.name: makeFeatureIdByTypeMap
methods.description: Constructs a map from feature type IDs to feature IDs based on HTTP request parameters, typically for form submissions.

methods.name: makeFeatureIdByTypeString
methods.description: Converts a map of feature type IDs and feature IDs into a URL query string format.

methods.name: makeProductFeatureCategoryIdListFromPrefixed
methods.description: Extracts a list of product feature category IDs from request parameters with a specific prefix.
